![Beginners Guide + Tips for the Full Moon Party, Thailand ...](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/07260109-1672-0139-0000-8e5ba6497423:6)
The Full Moon Party in Thailand is `a massive, all-night beach rave held monthly on Haad Rin Beach on Koh Phangan island` , featuring multiple music stages, fire shows, and neon body paint. Tickets cost ฿200 at the gate, and upcoming 2026 dates include July 31, August 28, and September 26.[](https://www.fullmoonpartythailand.com/) [[1]](https://www.fullmoonpartythailand.com/)[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Full_Moon_Party)[[3]](https://www.airasia.com/blog/thailand/surat-thani/full-moon-party-koh-phangan/)[[4]](https://www.fullmoonpartythailand.com/dates)

Location and Timing

- **Where:** Haad Rin Nok Beach (Sunrise Beach) on Koh Phangan, Surat Thani Province.
- **When:** Every month on the night of the full moon (or a day before/after if it hits a holy day).
- **Hours:** Starts around sunset and runs until sunrise.[](https://www.instagram.com/fullmoonpartykohphangan/) [[1]](https://www.instagram.com/fullmoonpartykohphangan/)[[2]](https://adventure360.com/guidebook/article/thailand-full-moon-party-dates-guide)

What to Experience

- **Music:** Dozens of sound systems and stages playing EDM, techno, house, drum and bass, hip-hop, and reggae.
- **Entertainment:** Fire-skipping ropes, fire-dancing shows, and UV neon body painting stations.
- **Drinks:** Famous small plastic buckets filled with local alcohol mixes sold at beach stalls.[](https://www.fullmoonpartythailand.com/) [[1]](https://tipsthailand.nl/full-moon-party-thailand/)

Travel and Logistics

- **Getting There:** Take a speedboat or ferry from nearby Koh Samui (15–45 minutes) or Surat Thani on the mainland.
- **Where to Stay:** Stay directly on Koh Phangan to avoid chaotic late-night return boat queues, or book a round-trip speedboat from Koh Samui.
- **Entry:** The ฿200 cash fee at the beach entrance supports local community cleanup and infrastructure.[](https://www.fullmoonpartythailand.com/) 

Safety Tips

- **Footwear:** Wear sturdy shoes or sneakers instead of flip-flops to avoid cuts from broken glass on the sand.
- **Valuables:** Leave your passport and expensive items in your hotel safe; carry only necessary cash in a secure pouch.
- **Fire Hazards:** Watch out around fire-jumping ropes and flaming limbo sticks to prevent severe burns.[](https://www.lensofjen.org/full-moon-party-dos-and-donts/) [[1]](https://www.lensofjen.org/full-moon-party-dos-and-donts/)
